records.title: TabPFN-2.5: Advancing the State of the Art in Tabular Foundation Models
records.reason: The primary abstract focuses on tabular data and task quality; no LLM inference method is addressed.

records.title: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5: Fully Open Framework for Democratized Multimodal Training
records.reason: The primary text frames the contribution as democratizing multimodal training. It does not establish lower LLM inference compute, memory, latency, or throughput.

records.title: Protein Design with Guided Discrete Diffusion
records.reason: The primary method and experiments concern biological sequence generation and protein fitness. No language-model serving workload, transformer inference optimization, or resource result is evaluated.

records.title: DreamVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Dreamed with Comprehensive World Knowledge
records.reason: Keep borderline: the full text reports a 91 ms VLA inference path and omits prediction heads at inference, but does not compare an inference optimization or measure language-model resource savings. The method could matter to VLA deployment, yet efficiency is not its demonstrated contribution.

records.title: DexVLA: Vision-Language Model with Plug-In Diffusion Expert for General Robot Control
records.reason: The abstract’s efficiency claim concerns training, and experiments target manipulation/control performance rather than LLM serving.
